procedure_name: Motor Vehicle Road Tax Payment (Online Vahan)
summary: Payment of annual, quarterly, or one-time lifetime motor vehicle road tax online.
estimated_total_cost: Calculated based on engine cc / cost of vehicle (3% to 12%)

steps.title: Enter vehicle registration number
steps.description: Input vehicle registration number on Parivahan Vahan Citizen Services portal.

steps.title: Review calculated tax demand
steps.description: System calculates tax, penalties (if payment delayed), and green cess.

steps.title: Pay via integrated payment gateway
steps.description: Pay tax securely through net banking, debit card, or SBI ePay.

steps.title: Download official motor tax receipt
steps.description: Download official Tax Receipt with digital seal; updates Vahan database immediately.
